Q9Vt6NGBVBc: In 1772, amateur sumo wrestlers in present-day Niigata were performing to raise money for a local temple when a pair of sumo pros crashed their event. And since skilled performers brought in more customers, event promoters were eager to enlist the best wrestlers.
